options.content: |⬅ Portal home🚨 AWR Anomaly detection💾 Memory advisory|🔗 AWR+SAR correlation🖥️ SAR overview|📊 AWR trends🤖 AI Recs page

⚠️
Advisory Disclaimer Recommendations generated by this tool (Rules Mode or AI Mode) are based on AWR snapshot data and statistical analysis. They are provided for guidance purposes only. All recommendations must be reviewed, validated, and tested in a non-production environment before implementation. The impact of any change is workload-specific and may vary significantly by environment. Avekshaa Technologies accepts no liability for outcomes resulting from implementation without appropriate DBA review and testing.

AI mode is active. Recommendations are generated by the AI engine — not shown here.
🤖 Go to AI Recommendations page → to generate, review, accept or reject AI recommendations.

1. Select Database → Instance → Start Snap → End Snap from the dropdowns above.
2. The three rows below show Wait Events · SQL · Segments as donut charts + RAG tables (🔴🟠🟡🟢).
3. Click any row in the Wait Events, SQL, or Segments table to drill in — the Correlation panel will automatically populate with linked objects + recommendation.
Tip: Use Wait Scope (All / Foreground / Background) and RAG Mode (normalized / percentile) to adjust scoring sensitivity.

panels.title: 📊 Top Issues — Wait Events · SQL · Segments (RAG Scored)

targets.rawSql: WITH f AS (  SELECT begin_snap, event::text AS event, SUM(pct_time) AS event_pct_snap  FROM awr_wait_summary_mv  WHERE dbname='$dbname'    AND instance='$instance'    AND begin_snap BETWEEN split_part('$start_snap',' - ',1)::int AND split_part('$end_snap',' - ',1)::int    AND ( '$wait_scope' IN ('', 'All') OR wait_scope = '$wait_scope' )  GROUP BY begin_snap, event ), t AS (  SELECT begin_snap, SUM(pct_time) AS total_pct_snap  FROM awr_wait_summary_mv  WHERE dbname='$dbname'    AND instance='$instance'    AND begin_snap BETWEEN split_part('$start_snap',' - ',1)::int AND split_part('$end_snap',' - ',1)::int    AND ( '$wait_scope' IN ('', 'All') OR wait_scope = '$wait_scope' )  GROUP BY begin_snap ) SELECT f.event AS name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(f.event_pct_snap) / NULLIF(SUM(t.total_pct_snap),0), 2) AS value FROM f JOIN t USING (begin_snap) GROUP BY f.event ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH base AS (
SELECT s.begin_snap,s.event::text AS event, COALESCE(m.wait_class, 'Other') AS wait_class, SUM(s.pct_time) AS event_pct_snap
FROM awr_wait_summary_mv s
 LEFT JOIN awr_wait_event_master m
ON TRIM(LOWER(s.event)) = TRIM(LOWER(m.event))
WHERE s.dbname = '$dbname' AND s.instance = '$instance'
AND s.begin_snap BETWEEN split_part('$start_snap',' - ',1)::int
AND split_part('$end_snap',' - ',1)::int
AND ( '$wait_scope' IN ('', 'All') OR s.wait_scope = '$wait_scope' )
GROUP BY s.begin_snap, s.event, m.wait_class),
tot AS (
SELECT s.begin_snap, SUM(s.pct_time) AS total_pct_snap
FROM awr_wait_summary_mv s
WHERE s.dbname = '$dbname'
AND s.instance = '$instance'
AND s.begin_snap BETWEEN split_part('$start_snap',' - ',1)::int
AND split_part('$end_snap',' - ',1)::int
AND ( '$wait_scope' IN ('', 'All') OR s.wait_scope = '$wait_scope' )
GROUP BY s.begin_snap)
SELECT b.wait_class, b.event,
ROUND( 100.0 * SUM(b.event_pct_snap) / NULLIF(SUM(t.total_pct_snap), 0), 2 ) AS severity_score,
CASE
WHEN ROUND( 100.0 * SUM(b.event_pct_snap) / NULLIF(SUM(t.total_pct_snap), 0), 2 ) >= 80 THEN '🔴'
WHEN ROUND( 100.0 * SUM(b.event_pct_snap) / NULLIF(SUM(t.total_pct_snap), 0), 2 ) BETWEEN 41 AND 79 THEN '🟠'
WHEN ROUND( 100.0 * SUM(b.event_pct_snap) / NULLIF(SUM(t.total_pct_snap), 0), 2 ) BETWEEN 11 AND 40 THEN '🟡'
ELSE '🟢'
END AS severity_rag
FROM base b
JOIN tot t USING (begin_snap)
GROUP BY b.wait_class, b.event
ORDER BY severity_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT sql_id::text AS name, ROUND(AVG(severity_score)::numeric,2) AS value FROM awr_sql_summary_mv WHERE '$dbname'!='' AND '$instance'!='' AND '$start_snap'!='' AND '$end_snap'!=''   AND dbname='$dbname' AND instance='$instance'   AND begin_snap BETWEEN split_part('$start_snap',' - ',1)::int AND split_part('$end_snap',' - ',1)::int GROUP BY sql_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH base AS (  SELECT sql_id, AVG(severity_score) AS score   FROM awr_sql_summary_mv   WHERE dbname='$dbname' AND instance='$instance'     AND begin_snap BETWEEN split_part('$start_snap',' - ',1)::int AND split_part('$end_snap',' - ',1)::int   GROUP BY sql_id ), bl AS (   SELECT     percentile_cont(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s) AS p10,     percentile_cont(0.40) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s) AS p40,     percentile_cont(0.70) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s) AS p70,     percentile_cont(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s) AS p90   FROM (     SELECT AVG(severity_score) AS s     FROM awr_sql_summary_mv     WHERE dbname='$dbname' AND instance='$instance'       AND snap_time >= now() - concat('$baseline_days',' days')::interval     GROUP BY sql_id, begin_snap   ) t ), norm AS (   SELECT b.*, GREATEST(0, LEAST(100, 100 * (b.score - bl.p10) / NULLIF(bl.p90 - bl.p10, 0))) AS score_norm   FROM base b CROSS JOIN bl ) SELECT b.sql_id, CASE WHEN '$rag_mode'='percentile' THEN   CASE WHEN b.score >= bl.p90 THEN '🔴'        WHEN b.score >= bl.p70 THEN '🟠'        WHEN b.score >= bl.p40 THEN '🟡'        ELSE '🟢' END ELSE   CASE WHEN n.score_norm >= 80 THEN '🔴'        WHEN n.score_norm >= 41 THEN '🟠'        WHEN n.score_norm >= 11 THEN '🟡'        ELSE '🟢' END END AS severity_rag FROM base b CROSS JOIN bl LEFT JOIN norm n USING (sql_id) ORDER BY b.score DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT object_name::text AS name, ROUND(AVG(severity_score)::numeric,2) AS value FROM awr_segment_summary_mv WHERE '$dbname'!='' AND '$instance'!='' AND '$start_snap'!='' AND '$end_snap'!=''   AND dbname='$dbname' AND instance='$instance'   AND begin_snap BETWEEN split_part('$start_snap',' - ',1)::int AND split_part('$end_snap',' - ',1)::int GROUP BY object_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH base AS (  SELECT owner, object_name, obj_type, COALESCE(subobject_name,'') AS subobject_name,         AVG(severity_score) AS score   FROM awr_segment_summary_mv   WHERE dbname='$dbname' AND instance='$instance'     AND begin_snap BETWEEN split_part('$start_snap',' - ',1)::int AND split_part('$end_snap',' - ',1)::int   GROUP BY owner, object_name, obj_type, subobject_name ), bl AS (   SELECT     percentile_cont(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s) AS p10,     percentile_cont(0.40) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s) AS p40,     percentile_cont(0.70) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s) AS p70,     percentile_cont(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s) AS p90   FROM (     SELECT AVG(severity_score) AS s     FROM awr_segment_summary_mv     WHERE dbname='$dbname' AND instance='$instance'       AND snap_time >= now() - concat('$baseline_days',' days')::interval     GROUP BY owner, object_name, obj_type, COALESCE(subobject_name,'')   ) t ), norm AS (   SELECT b.*, GREATEST(0, LEAST(100, 100 * (b.score - bl.p10) / NULLIF(bl.p90 - bl.p10, 0))) AS score_norm   FROM base b CROSS JOIN bl ) SELECT b.owner, b.object_name, b.obj_type, b.subobject_name, CASE WHEN '$rag_mode'='percentile' THEN   CASE WHEN b.score >= bl.p90 THEN '🔴'        WHEN b.score >= bl.p70 THEN '🟠'        WHEN b.score >= bl.p40 THEN '🟡'        ELSE '🟢' END ELSE   CASE WHEN n.score_norm >= 80 THEN '🔴'        WHEN n.score_norm >= 41 THEN '🟠'        WHEN n.score_norm >= 11 THEN '🟡'        ELSE '🟢' END END AS severity_rag FROM base b CROSS JOIN bl LEFT JOIN norm n USING (owner, object_name, obj_type, subobject_name) ORDER BY b.score DESC LIMIT 10;

panels.title: 🔗 Correlation & Drill-down (set Focus Type + Focus Value + Open Drawer=true)

targets.rawSql:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    lower(NULLIF('${open_drawer}','')) AS open_flag,
    lower(NULLIF('${focus_type}',''))  AS ftype,
    lower(NULLIF('${focus_value}','')) AS fval,
    lower(NULLIF('${wait_scope}',''))  AS scope_txt,
    '${start_snap}'                    AS s_label,
    '${end_snap}'                      AS e_label,
    split_part('${start_snap}',' - ',1)::int AS s_snap,
    split_part('${end_snap}',' - ',1)::int   AS e_snap,
    '${dbname}'                        AS dbname,
    '${instance}'                      AS instance
),

-- Window-scoped waits (carry wait_class and wait_scope for master lookup)
win_waits AS (
  SELECT w.event, ROUND(AVG(w.pct_time),2) AS wait_pct,
         MAX(w.wait_scope) AS wait_scope,
         MAX(w.wait_class) AS wait_class
  FROM awr_wait_summary_mv w
  JOIN params p ON p.dbname=w.dbname AND p.instance=w.instance
  WHERE w.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
    AND ( (SELECT scope_txt FROM params) IN ('','all')
          OR lower(w.wait_scope) = (SELECT scope_txt FROM params) )
  GROUP BY w.event
),

-- Object metadata enrichment
obj_meta AS (
  SELECT
    UPPER(m.owner)       AS owner,
    UPPER(m.object_name) AS object_name,
    UPPER(m.object_type) AS object_type,
    m.num_rows, m.blevel, m.clustering_factor,
    m.index_type, m.partitioned, m.compression, m.last_analyzed,
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(m.object_type) IN ('INDEX','INDEX PARTITION','INDEX SUBPARTITION',
                                     'LOB INDEX','CLUSTER INDEX') THEN
        CONCAT(
          ' [',
          CASE WHEN m.blevel IS NOT NULL THEN 'BLVL='||m.blevel::text ELSE '' END,
          CASE WHEN m.clustering_factor IS NOT NULL AND m.num_rows > 0
               THEN ' CF='||ROUND(m.clustering_factor::numeric/m.num_rows,2)::text ELSE '' END,
          CASE WHEN m.index_type IS NOT NULL AND m.index_type NOT IN ('NORMAL','')
               THEN ' '||m.index_type ELSE '' END,
          CASE WHEN m.blevel > 4 THEN ' ⚠BLVL-HIGH' ELSE '' END,
          CASE WHEN m.clustering_factor IS NOT NULL AND m.num_rows > 0
                    AND (m.clustering_factor::numeric/m.num_rows) > 0.5
               THEN ' ⚠CF-POOR' ELSE '' END,
          CASE WHEN m.last_analyzed IS NOT NULL
                    AND (NOW()-m.last_analyzed) > INTERVAL '30 days'
               THEN ' ⚠STALE-STATS' ELSE '' END,
          ']'
        )
      WHEN UPPER(m.object_type) IN ('TABLE','TABLE PARTITION','TABLE SUBPARTITION','CLUSTER') THEN
        CONCAT(
          ' [',
          CASE WHEN m.num_rows IS NOT NULL
               THEN 'rows='||TO_CHAR(m.num_rows,'FM999,999,999') ELSE '' END,
          CASE WHEN m.partitioned='YES' THEN ' PART' ELSE '' END,
          CASE WHEN m.compression='ENABLED' THEN ' COMP' ELSE '' END,
          CASE WHEN m.last_analyzed IS NOT NULL
                    AND (NOW()-m.last_analyzed) > INTERVAL '30 days'
               THEN ' ⚠STALE-STATS' ELSE '' END,
          ']'
        )
      WHEN UPPER(m.object_type) IN ('LOB','LOB PARTITION') THEN ' [LOB: check SecureFile+CACHE]'
      WHEN UPPER(m.object_type) IN ('ROLLBACK','TYPE2 UNDO')  THEN ' [UNDO: check retention]'
      ELSE
        CASE WHEN m.last_analyzed IS NOT NULL
                  AND (NOW()-m.last_analyzed) > INTERVAL '30 days'
             THEN ' [⚠STALE-STATS]' ELSE '' END
    END AS meta_label
  FROM awr_object_metadata m
  JOIN params p ON UPPER(m.dbname)=UPPER(p.dbname)
  WHERE (m.last_analyzed IS NOT NULL OR m.num_rows IS NOT NULL OR m.blevel IS NOT NULL)
),

/* =========================
   SQL focus (hybrid)
   ========================= */
focus_sql AS (
  SELECT fval AS sql_id FROM params
  WHERE (SELECT ftype FROM params)='sql' AND fval<>''
),

sql_seg_text AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.owner, s.object_name, s.obj_type
  FROM awr_sql_object_map_mv m
  JOIN awr_segment_summary_mv s
    ON ( (m.owner<>'' AND lower(s.owner)=m.owner AND lower(s.object_name)=m.object)
      OR (m.owner=''  AND lower(s.object_name)=m.object) )
  JOIN params p ON p.dbname=s.dbname AND p.instance=s.instance
  WHERE m.sql_id=(SELECT sql_id FROM focus_sql LIMIT 1)
    AND s.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
),

sql_snap AS ( SELECT * FROM awr_sql_score_by_snap ),
seg_snap AS ( SELECT * FROM awr_seg_score_by_snap ),

sql_seg_cooccur AS (
  SELECT se.owner, se.object_name, se.obj_type,
         SUM(se.seg_score_snap * sq.sql_score_snap) AS co_score
  FROM seg_snap se
  JOIN sql_snap sq
    ON sq.dbname=se.dbname AND sq.instance=se.instance AND sq.begin_snap=se.begin_snap
  JOIN params p ON p.dbname=se.dbname AND p.instance=se.instance
  WHERE sq.sql_id=(SELECT sql_id FROM focus_sql LIMIT 1)
    AND se.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
  GROUP BY se.owner, se.object_name, se.obj_type
),

sql_seg_union AS (
  SELECT owner, object_name, obj_type, 1000::numeric AS rank_signal FROM sql_seg_text
  UNION
  SELECT owner, object_name, obj_type, COALESCE(co_score,0) FROM sql_seg_cooccur
),

sql_seg_ranked AS (
  SELECT u.owner, u.object_name, u.obj_type,
         MAX(u.rank_signal)    AS rank_signal_max,
         AVG(s.severity_score) AS seg_score_avg,
         MAX(om.meta_label)    AS meta_label
  FROM sql_seg_union u
  JOIN awr_segment_summary_mv s
    ON lower(s.owner)=lower(u.owner)
   AND lower(s.object_name)=lower(u.object_name)
   AND s.obj_type=u.obj_type
  JOIN params p ON p.dbname=s.dbname AND p.instance=s.instance
  LEFT JOIN obj_meta om ON om.owner=UPPER(u.owner) AND om.object_name=UPPER(u.object_name)
  WHERE s.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
  GROUP BY u.owner, u.object_name, u.obj_type
),

block_sql_segments AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
           string_agg(
             '• '||owner||'.'||object_name||' ('||obj_type
             ||') [score='||ROUND(seg_score_avg,2)::text||']'
             ||COALESCE(meta_label,''),
             E'\n' ORDER BY rank_signal_max DESC, seg_score_avg DESC
           ), '—'
         ) AS txt
  FROM sql_seg_ranked
),

block_sql_waits AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
           string_agg('• '||event||' ['||ROUND(wait_pct,2)::text||'%]',
                      E'\n' ORDER BY wait_pct DESC),
           '—'
         ) AS txt
  FROM win_waits
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_sql)
),

block_sql_other_sqls AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
           string_agg('• '||x.sql_id, E'\n'
                      ORDER BY x.rank_signal DESC, x.sql_score DESC NULLS LAST),
           '—'
         ) AS txt
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.sql_id, 1000::numeric AS rank_signal,
           (SELECT AVG(severity_score)
              FROM awr_sql_summary_mv q
              JOIN params p ON p.dbname=q.dbname AND p.instance=q.instance
             WHERE lower(q.sql_id)=m.sql_id
               AND q.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
           ) AS sql_score
    FROM sql_seg_ranked r
    JOIN awr_sql_object_map_mv m
      ON ( (m.owner<>'' AND m.owner=lower(r.owner) AND m.object=lower(r.object_name))
        OR (m.owner=''  AND m.object=lower(r.object_name)) )
    WHERE m.sql_id<>(SELECT sql_id FROM focus_sql)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sq.sql_id,
           SUM(se.seg_score_snap * sq.sql_score_snap) AS rank_signal,
           AVG(sq.sql_score_snap) AS sql_score
    FROM sql_seg_ranked r
    JOIN seg_snap se ON lower(se.owner)=lower(r.owner) AND lower(se.object_name)=lower(r.object_name)
    JOIN sql_snap sq ON sq.dbname=se.dbname AND sq.instance=se.instance AND sq.begin_snap=se.begin_snap
    WHERE sq.sql_id<>(SELECT sql_id FROM focus_sql)
    GROUP BY sq.sql_id
  ) x
),

/* =========================
   WAIT focus
   ========================= */
focus_wait AS (
  SELECT fval AS event FROM params
  WHERE (SELECT ftype FROM params)='wait' AND fval<>''
),

-- Look up the focused event in awr_wait_event_master.
-- corr_type, seg_filter, has_specific_rule, and guidance_text
-- drive all wait-focus behaviour: segment routing, filtering, and messaging.
-- Falls back to class-level defaults if the event is not yet seeded.
focus_wait_meta AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      m.corr_type,
      -- Class-level fallback when event not yet seeded
      CASE
        WHEN ww.wait_scope = 'Background'    THEN 'none'
        WHEN ww.wait_class = 'User I/O'      THEN 'io_read'
        WHEN ww.wait_class = 'System I/O'    THEN 'io_write'
        WHEN ww.wait_class = 'Application'   THEN 'row_lock'
        WHEN ww.wait_class = 'Cluster'       THEN 'gc_cluster'
        WHEN ww.wait_class = 'Concurrency'
             AND lower(ww.event) NOT LIKE '%latch%'
             AND lower(ww.event) NOT LIKE '%mutex%'
             AND lower(ww.event) NOT LIKE '%library cache%'
             AND lower(ww.event) NOT LIKE '%shared pool%'
             AND lower(ww.event) NOT LIKE '%cursor%'
                                              THEN 'buffer_busy'
        ELSE 'none'
      END
    ) AS corr_type,
    COALESCE(m.seg_filter, 'all') AS seg_filter,
    COALESCE(m.has_specific_rule, false) AS has_specific_rule,
    -- Build the message shown in the correlation panel
    CASE
      WHEN m.corr_type IS NOT NULL AND m.corr_type <> 'none' THEN
        -- Has segment correlation: show basis and guidance as supplementary info
        CASE m.corr_type
          WHEN 'io_read'     THEN 'Correlated by: '||
            CASE COALESCE(m.seg_filter,'all')
              WHEN 'index_only' THEN 'physical reads — INDEX segments only (single-block reads are index-driven, not table-driven)'
              WHEN 'table_only' THEN 'physical reads — TABLE/LOB segments only (multi-block/direct-path reads target table extents)'
              ELSE 'physical reads — segments generating the most physical I/O in this snap range'
            END
          WHEN 'io_write'    THEN 'Correlated by: physical writes — segments written most by background write processes'
          WHEN 'buffer_busy' THEN 'Correlated by: buffer busy waits — segments with the most block-level contention'
          WHEN 'row_lock'    THEN 'Correlated by: row lock waits — segments with the most row-level locking activity'
          WHEN 'gc_cluster'  THEN 'Correlated by: GC buffer busy — segments with the most RAC cross-instance block transfers'
          ELSE 'Correlation basis determined'
        END
      WHEN m.guidance_text IS NOT NULL THEN
        -- No segment correlation: show full guidance from master table
        m.guidance_text ||
        CASE WHEN m.has_specific_rule
             THEN E'\n\n→ Full recommendation detail available in the Active Recommendations panel below.'
             ELSE '' END
      WHEN ww.wait_scope = 'Background' THEN
        'Background process wait — no user segment correlation.' || E'\n' ||
        'Background processes (RMAN, LGWR, ARCn, DBWR) operate on datafiles and redo logs, not user segments.' || E'\n' ||
        'Top 3 actions: (1) Check SAR I/O and network dashboards for storage or interconnect bottlenecks. (2) Review background process alert log entries. (3) Correlate with foreground wait events to identify downstream impact on user sessions.'
      WHEN ww.wait_class IN ('Commit','Configuration') THEN
        'Redo/configuration wait — no segment correlation.' || E'\n' ||
        'This event reflects redo log or instance configuration constraints, not activity on any specific segment.' || E'\n' ||
        'Top 3 actions: (1) Review redo log sizing and storage latency on SAR dashboard. (2) Check log switch frequency. (3) See Active Recommendations panel for parameter tuning guidance.'
      WHEN ww.wait_class = 'Network' THEN
        'Network wait — no segment correlation.' || E'\n' ||
        'This event reflects session or network latency between client and server.' || E'\n' ||
        'Top 3 actions: (1) Check network latency between DB and application tier. (2) Review connection pool settings and idle session timeout. (3) For dblink waits: check remote DB performance and network bandwidth.'
      WHEN ww.wait_class = 'Idle' THEN
        'Idle wait — sessions waiting for client requests. Not a database bottleneck.' || E'\n' ||
        'Top 3 actions: (1) If this dominates DB time, focus on the non-idle waits above. (2) Review connection pool min/max sizing. (3) Implement idle session timeout.'
      WHEN ww.wait_class = 'Concurrency' THEN
        'Memory structure contention (latch/mutex/library cache) — no segment correlation.' || E'\n' ||
        'These waits reflect in-memory structure contention, not segment I/O.' || E'\n' ||
        'Top 3 actions: (1) Enforce bind variable usage to reduce hard parsing. (2) Increase SHARED_POOL_SIZE. (3) Pin critical PL/SQL with DBMS_SHARED_POOL.KEEP.'
      ELSE
        'No segment correlation available for this wait event (class: '||
        COALESCE(ww.wait_class,'unknown')||').' || E'\n' ||
        'Top 3 actions: (1) Check Oracle documentation for this specific event. (2) Correlate with Top SQL dashboard to find SQLs contributing to this wait. (3) Review SAR dashboard for concurrent OS-level bottlenecks.'
    END AS display_msg,
    -- Guidance to append after correlated segments (for events that DO have segments)
    CASE WHEN m.corr_type IS NOT NULL AND m.corr_type <> 'none' AND m.guidance_text IS NOT NULL
         THEN m.guidance_text ||
              CASE WHEN m.has_specific_rule
                   THEN E'\n\n→ Full recommendation detail in the Active Recommendations panel below.'
                   ELSE '' END
         ELSE NULL
    END AS segment_advisory
  FROM win_waits ww
  LEFT JOIN awr_wait_event_master m ON lower(m.event) = lower(ww.event)
  WHERE lower(ww.event) = (SELECT event FROM focus_wait LIMIT 1)
  LIMIT 1
),

-- Correlated segments — filtered by corr_type AND seg_filter from master table.
-- Each branch fires only when corr_type matches; seg_filter restricts obj_type.
wait_corr_segments AS (

  -- USER I/O — physical reads
  -- seg_filter controls which obj_types are shown:
  --   index_only: INDEX family only (db file sequential read)
  --   table_only: TABLE/LOB/CLUSTER (direct path read, db file scattered read)
  --   all:        no restriction
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT s.owner, s.object_name, s.obj_type,
           s.physical_reads AS metric_value,
           'physical_reads' AS metric_name,
           MAX(om.meta_label) AS meta_label
    FROM awr_segment_summary_mv s
    JOIN params p ON p.dbname=s.dbname AND p.instance=s.instance
    LEFT JOIN obj_meta om ON om.owner=UPPER(s.owner) AND om.object_name=UPPER(s.object_name)
    WHERE s.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
      AND s.physical_reads IS NOT NULL AND s.physical_reads > 0
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_wait_meta WHERE corr_type='io_read')
      -- seg_filter: index_only restricts to index family; table_only to table/LOB; all = no filter
      AND (
        (SELECT seg_filter FROM focus_wait_meta) = 'all'
        OR (
          (SELECT seg_filter FROM focus_wait_meta) = 'index_only'
          AND UPPER(s.obj_type) IN ('INDEX','INDEX PARTITION','INDEX SUBPARTITION',
                                     'LOB INDEX','CLUSTER INDEX','ROLLBACK','TYPE2 UNDO')
        )
        OR (
          (SELECT seg_filter FROM focus_wait_meta) = 'table_only'
          AND UPPER(s.obj_type) IN ('TABLE','TABLE PARTITION','TABLE SUBPARTITION',
                                     'CLUSTER','LOB','LOB PARTITION')
        )
      )
    GROUP BY s.owner, s.object_name, s.obj_type, s.physical_reads
    ORDER BY s.physical_reads DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) t1

  UNION ALL

  -- SYSTEM I/O — physical writes (DBWR, direct path writes)
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT s.owner, s.object_name, s.obj_type,
           s.physical_writes AS metric_value,
           'physical_writes' AS metric_name,
           MAX(om.meta_label) AS meta_label
    FROM awr_segment_summary_mv s
    JOIN params p ON p.dbname=s.dbname AND p.instance=s.instance
    LEFT JOIN obj_meta om ON om.owner=UPPER(s.owner) AND om.object_name=UPPER(s.object_name)
    WHERE s.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
      AND s.physical_writes IS NOT NULL AND s.physical_writes > 0
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_wait_meta WHERE corr_type='io_write')
    GROUP BY s.owner, s.object_name, s.obj_type, s.physical_writes
    ORDER BY s.physical_writes DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) t2

  UNION ALL

  -- CONCURRENCY — buffer busy waits (buffer busy, read by other, free buffer)
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT s.owner, s.object_name, s.obj_type,
           s.buffer_busy_waits AS metric_value,
           'buffer_busy_waits' AS metric_name,
           MAX(om.meta_label) AS meta_label
    FROM awr_segment_summary_mv s
    JOIN params p ON p.dbname=s.dbname AND p.instance=s.instance
    LEFT JOIN obj_meta om ON om.owner=UPPER(s.owner) AND om.object_name=UPPER(s.object_name)
    WHERE s.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
      AND s.buffer_busy_waits IS NOT NULL AND s.buffer_busy_waits > 0
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_wait_meta WHERE corr_type='buffer_busy')
    GROUP BY s.owner, s.object_name, s.obj_type, s.buffer_busy_waits
    ORDER BY s.buffer_busy_waits DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) t3

  UNION ALL

  -- APPLICATION — row lock waits (enq: TX, enq: TM)
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT s.owner, s.object_name, s.obj_type,
           s.row_lock_waits AS metric_value,
           'row_lock_waits' AS metric_name,
           MAX(om.meta_label) AS meta_label
    FROM awr_segment_summary_mv s
    JOIN params p ON p.dbname=s.dbname AND p.instance=s.instance
    LEFT JOIN obj_meta om ON om.owner=UPPER(s.owner) AND om.object_name=UPPER(s.object_name)
    WHERE s.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
      AND s.row_lock_waits IS NOT NULL AND s.row_lock_waits > 0
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_wait_meta WHERE corr_type='row_lock')
    GROUP BY s.owner, s.object_name, s.obj_type, s.row_lock_waits
    ORDER BY s.row_lock_waits DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) t4

  UNION ALL

  -- CLUSTER — RAC GC buffer busy
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT s.owner, s.object_name, s.obj_type,
           s.gc_buffer_busy AS metric_value,
           'gc_buffer_busy' AS metric_name,
           MAX(om.meta_label) AS meta_label
    FROM awr_segment_summary_mv s
    JOIN params p ON p.dbname=s.dbname AND p.instance=s.instance
    LEFT JOIN obj_meta om ON om.owner=UPPER(s.owner) AND om.object_name=UPPER(s.object_name)
    WHERE s.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
      AND s.gc_buffer_busy IS NOT NULL AND s.gc_buffer_busy > 0
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_wait_meta WHERE corr_type='gc_cluster')
    GROUP BY s.owner, s.object_name, s.obj_type, s.gc_buffer_busy
    ORDER BY s.gc_buffer_busy DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) t5
),

-- SQLs referencing the correlated segments
wait_corr_seg_sqls AS (
  SELECT cs.owner, cs.object_name, cs.obj_type, cs.metric_value, cs.metric_name,
         cs.meta_label,
         COALESCE(
           (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT m.sql_id, ', ' ORDER BY m.sql_id)
            FROM awr_sql_object_map_mv m
            WHERE (m.owner<>'' AND m.owner=lower(cs.owner) AND m.object=lower(cs.object_name))
               OR (m.owner=''  AND m.object=lower(cs.object_name))
           ),
           (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT sq.sql_id, ', ' ORDER BY sq.sql_id)
            FROM seg_snap se
            JOIN sql_snap sq ON sq.dbname=se.dbname AND sq.instance=se.instance
                             AND sq.begin_snap=se.begin_snap
            WHERE lower(se.owner)=lower(cs.owner)
              AND lower(se.object_name)=lower(cs.object_name)
           ),
           '—'
         ) AS sql_ids
  FROM wait_corr_segments cs
),

block_wait_segments AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
           string_agg(
             '• '||owner||'.'||object_name||' ('||obj_type
             ||') ['||metric_name||'='||ROUND(metric_value::numeric,0)::text||']'
             ||COALESCE(meta_label,''),
             E'\n' ORDER BY metric_value DESC
           ), NULL
         ) AS txt
  FROM wait_corr_seg_sqls
),

block_wait_sqls AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
           string_agg(
             '• '||owner||'.'||object_name||' → '||sql_ids,
             E'\n' ORDER BY metric_value DESC
           ), NULL
         ) AS txt
  FROM wait_corr_seg_sqls
  WHERE sql_ids<>'—'
),

/* =========================
   SEGMENT focus
   ========================= */
focus_segment AS (
  SELECT lower(NULLIF('${focus_value}','')) AS obj_txt
  WHERE (SELECT ftype FROM params)='segment' AND (SELECT fval FROM params)<>''
),

seg_obj AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.owner, s.object_name, s.obj_type,
         om.meta_label
  FROM awr_segment_summary_mv s
  JOIN params p ON p.dbname=s.dbname AND p.instance=s.instance
  LEFT JOIN obj_meta om ON om.owner=UPPER(s.owner) AND om.object_name=UPPER(s.object_name)
  WHERE s.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
    AND (
         lower(s.object_name)=(SELECT obj_txt FROM focus_segment)
         OR lower(s.owner||'.'||s.object_name)=(SELECT obj_txt FROM focus_segment)
        )
),

block_seg_waits AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
           string_agg('• '||event||' ['||ROUND(wait_pct,2)::text||'%]',
                      E'\n' ORDER BY wait_pct DESC),
           '—'
         ) AS txt
  FROM win_waits
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seg_obj)
),

block_seg_sqls AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
           string_agg('• '||sql_id, E'\n' ORDER BY avg_sql_score DESC NULLS LAST),
           '—'
         ) AS txt
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.sql_id,
           (SELECT AVG(severity_score)
              FROM awr_sql_summary_mv q
              JOIN params p ON p.dbname=q.dbname AND p.instance=q.instance
             WHERE lower(q.sql_id)=m.sql_id
               AND q.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
           ) AS avg_sql_score,
           1 AS pref
    FROM seg_obj o
    JOIN awr_sql_object_map_mv m
      ON ( (m.owner<>'' AND m.owner=lower(o.owner) AND m.object=lower(o.object_name))
        OR (m.owner=''  AND m.object=lower(o.object_name)) )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sq.sql_id, AVG(sq.sql_score_snap) AS avg_sql_score, 2 AS pref
    FROM seg_obj o
    JOIN seg_snap se ON lower(se.owner)=lower(o.owner) AND lower(se.object_name)=lower(o.object_name)
    JOIN sql_snap sq ON sq.dbname=se.dbname AND sq.instance=se.instance AND sq.begin_snap=se.begin_snap
    GROUP BY sq.sql_id
  ) u
),

/* =========================
   Final rows
   ========================= */
rows AS (
  SELECT 1 AS ord, 'Focus' AS section,
         CASE WHEN (SELECT ftype FROM params)<>''
              THEN (SELECT ftype FROM params)||': '||COALESCE((SELECT fval FROM params),'—')
              ELSE '—' END AS value

  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2, 'Signals',
         'Scope: '||COALESCE((SELECT scope_txt FROM params),'all')
         ||' | Range: '||(SELECT s_label FROM params)||' → '||(SELECT e_label FROM params)

  -- WAIT: correlation basis / advisory message (always shown for wait focus)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, 'Correlation Basis / Advisory',
         (SELECT display_msg FROM focus_wait_meta)
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_wait)

  -- WAIT: correlated segments (only when corr_type != 'none' AND segments found)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 4, 'Correlated Segments',
         (SELECT txt FROM block_wait_segments)
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_wait)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_wait_meta WHERE corr_type<>'none')
    AND (SELECT txt FROM block_wait_segments) IS NOT NULL

  -- WAIT: SQLs referencing those segments
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 5, 'SQLs referencing correlated segments',
         (SELECT txt FROM block_wait_sqls)
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_wait)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_wait_meta WHERE corr_type<>'none')
    AND (SELECT txt FROM block_wait_sqls) IS NOT NULL

  -- WAIT: segment-level advisory (guidance text appended after segments, for events with both)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 6, 'Tuning Advisory',
         (SELECT segment_advisory FROM focus_wait_meta)
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_wait)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_wait_meta WHERE corr_type<>'none')
    AND (SELECT segment_advisory FROM focus_wait_meta) IS NOT NULL

  -- SQL focus rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, 'Segments referenced by SQL', (SELECT txt FROM block_sql_segments)
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_sql)

  UNION ALL
  SELECT 4, 'Other SQLs using these objects', (SELECT txt FROM block_sql_other_sqls)
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_sql)

  UNION ALL
  SELECT 5, 'Top Waits (window)', (SELECT txt FROM block_sql_waits)
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM focus_sql)

  -- SEGMENT focus rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, 'Top Waits (window)', (SELECT txt FROM block_seg_waits)
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seg_obj)

  UNION ALL
  SELECT 4, 'Top SQLs for this segment', (SELECT txt FROM block_seg_sqls)
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seg_obj)

  UNION ALL
  SELECT 5, 'Object Metadata', (
    SELECT COALESCE(
             string_agg(
               owner||'.'||object_name||' ('||obj_type||')'||COALESCE(meta_label,''),
               E'\n'
             ),
             'No metadata available — upload object metadata via Settings → Metadata Upload'
           )
    FROM seg_obj
  )
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seg_obj)
)
SELECT section, value
FROM rows, params p
WHERE p.open_flag = 'true'
ORDER BY ord;

list.label: Database

list.query: SELECT value, label FROM (  SELECT '' AS value, '' AS label  UNION ALL  SELECT DISTINCT dbname AS value, dbname AS label  FROM awr_load_profile) AS t ORDER BY value;

list.label: Instance
list.name: instance
list.query: SELECT value, label FROM (  SELECT '' AS value, '' AS label  UNION ALL  SELECT DISTINCT instance AS value, instance AS label  FROM awr_load_profile WHERE dbname='${dbname}') AS t ORDER BY value;

list.label: Start Snap
list.name: start_snap
list.query: SELECT '' AS label UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT begin_snap::int || ' - ' || to_char(snap_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM awr_load_profile WHERE dbname='${dbname}' AND instance='${instance}' ORDER BY label NULLS FIRST;

list.label: End Snap
list.name: end_snap
list.query: SELECT '' AS label UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT begin_snap::int || ' - ' || to_char(snap_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM awr_load_profile WHERE dbname='${dbname}' AND instance='${instance}' ORDER BY label NULLS FIRST;
